create_attention_module: create a multi-head self-attention module with configurable heads, dropout, and optional QKV bias for a vision transformer
init_attention_weights: initialize the Attention module weights with custom standard deviation values for qkv and projection layers
run_attention_forward: run the Attention forward pass on a tensor using scaled dot-product attention with optional causal masking
create_memeff_attention_module: create a memory-efficient attention module that uses xFormers for optimized attention with support for attention bias
run_memeff_attention_forward: run the MemEffAttention forward pass using xFormers memory-efficient attention or fall back to standard attention
